gate.ask.verbal: [OwnMind] ⛔ "{title}" needs your go-ahead for this action. Reply "go" to approve it once, or "no" to cancel.
gate.ask.code.action: [OwnMind] ⛔ "{title}" wants your approval for: this action. Approval code: {code} (paste it to the AI to allow it once)
gate.ask.code.limit: [OwnMind] ⛔ "{title}" wants your approval for: a command blocked 3 times in a row. Approval code: {code} (paste it to the AI to allow it once)
gate.read.blocked: [OwnMind] ⛔ blocked until the rule "{title}" is read (auto-unblocks on retry)
gate.failopen: [OwnMind] the action gate could not run - this command was NOT gated
gate.degraded: [OwnMind] the action gate could not run in full - receipts unavailable, checks still enforced
lint.recovered: [OwnMind] compliance checks are running again - this turn was checked
lint.offReminder:
[OwnMind v{version}] ⚠️ OwnMind is currently disabled ({tick} AI responses skipped lint)
  → Re-enable with /ownmind-on, or open a new conversation to restore
lint.banner.header.downgraded: [OwnMind v{version}] Reply quality lint ⚠️ {blockCount} consecutive blocks reached — downgrading to warning (please review manually to avoid a loop)
lint.banner.header.blocked: [OwnMind v{version}] Reply quality lint ⚠️ Block triggered — Claude will receive a rewrite directive (session count {count})
lint.banner.header.blockMode: [OwnMind v{version}] Reply quality lint (block mode, session count {count}, {remaining} more before block)
lint.banner.header.otherMode: [OwnMind v{version}] Reply quality lint ({mode} mode, session count {count})
lint.banner.modeInvalid: ⚠️  OWNMIND_REPLY_LINT_MODE='{rawMode}' is unrecognized — falling back to warn
compliance.off.warnMode: [OwnMind] compliance check is off for this session (lint disabled or warn mode)
compliance.notChecked.noCredentials: [OwnMind] this machine has no credentials, so this turn was NOT checked
compliance.notChecked.neverSynced: [OwnMind] this machine has never synced its rules, so this turn was NOT checked
compliance.notChecked.checkFailed: [OwnMind] compliance check did not run ({reason}) - this turn was NOT checked
compliance.off.server: [OwnMind] enforcement is switched off for this account, so this turn was NOT checked
compliance.idNote: [check {checkId}: say "誤判 {checkId}" if this is wrong]
compliance.blockCapReached: [OwnMind] the reply still breaks {count} rule(s) after {blockCount} rewrites - showing you instead of asking again{idNote}
compliance.pushedBack: [OwnMind] compliance: {count} rule violation(s) sent back to the AI{idNote}
